acceptance_criteria.criterion: PhysicsService uses real per-ship drag, inertia, and jerk values from ShipDef when a shipId is provided — no more hardcoded Drag(100,...), Inertia(10,...), Jerk(50,...)
ShipDataService.loadAllEngines() returns real reverse/boost/travel thrust values from EngineDef, not estimated multipliers
ShipDataService.getShipCargoCapacity() returns ShipDef.getCargoCapacity() for ships where it is available (>0)
PhysicsResponse includes topSpeed and acceleration fields (original and adjusted, null when no engine selected)
EnginePerformance DTO includes topSpeed, topSpeedReverse, topSpeedBoost, topSpeedTravel, and engine count
ShipDetails DTO includes engineCount, real drag/inertia/jerk values, and cargoType
PhysicsRequest accepts an optional shipId parameter
All existing API behavior continues to work when shipId is not provided (backward compatibility)
All new DTO properties are readonly
